notes.title: March 2025 Update - Trailer & Modes Overview!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/59770769ab289361111794199201d10bb4b9bd4b.png

First, check out this new trailer: 

https://youtu.be/vtxiPu7Cr8Q

Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you!  The entirety of Outbreak: Shades of Horror can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

Cypress Reel


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/9677a909a75b28e637ceb34b3a4f178b0716e163.png

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes!  You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more!  Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!

Story mode


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/8512ba1729ba7b2e84ea19f68d7346be4a2cc8b3.jpg

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting!  Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters.  Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.

Invasion mode


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/2170722194b67491d86f8398c70ef68f36ced3bf.jpg

A different flavor of survival.  You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents.  Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more.  Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle.  Multiple maps will be available!

Raid mode


This arcade-style experience is a blast.  Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out!  As with the rest of Outbreak: Shades of Horror, Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time.  Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.

Mini-games


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/7d7475934f99c250afa98975b54c30484bbe6e13.jpg

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces.  From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over.  Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when Outbreak: Shades of Horror begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year!  We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues.  Thank you as always for your support and patience.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 3 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/84af881a4de8ca531fad3bc7918e0214d96de8c4.jpg

Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

Patch 3
- Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.

notes.title: Railbreak Patch 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33023292/1ad558ba52773cb53b86bf159aa488a7e6dce9af.jpg

Hey Survivors!

Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!

Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!

Patch 2
- Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
- Added the Update Notes screen.
- High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
- Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
- Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
- Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
- Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
- Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
- Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
- Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
- Additional performance improvements across the title.
- Item highlights now appear at greater range.

Outbreak: Endless Nightmares twists the series' survival horror gameplay by adding elements of roguelike gameplay. You'll need to explore, hunt for supplies, uncover clues, and fight your way through each anomaly – each consisting of semi-procedurally generated instances where both the environment, and the undead, are out to kill you!

Immediately after the events of Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles, you find yourself trapped within the remains of Arzt Memorial Hospital – the hub to organize your inventory and storage cache, level up your character, or just to take a breather before venturing back out into the chaos. There’s more to discover in the world besides murderous hordes of the undead – find the journals scattered about to learn more about the outbreak and ultimately where to find refuge! Don’t think death can save you – every time you die, you'll awake trapped in this nexus.

Outbreak: Endless Nightmares focuses on extreme replayability by offering multiple character options – each with their own abilities, upgrade paths and more! Each time you venture into the anomaly, it’ll change and become increasingly difficult as you grow in power. You'll need to think carefully about what weapons, healing items, and other supplies you'll bring along. If you're lucky, you may find storage caches that give you access to your expanded inventory, and offer an opportunity to restock. But it's all on you to search your environment for supplies. If you run out ... your fate is sealed!
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-KeyFeatures-600.jpg?t=1618691544
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1419350/extras/OEN-steamgif-tactical-01.gif?t=1618691544

Something Old, Something New: Outbreak’s signature classic survival gameplay mixed with roguelike elements.
An Expanding World: Explore a massive, semi-procedurally generated world that expands as the game progresses! Talk to NPCs, visit shops, etc.
Three Camera Angles: Choose a view that works for you – Fixed camera, over the shoulder, or first person. 
Photo Mode: Take beautiful pictures with the camera or use the photo mode to scan or anything dangerous nearby!
Death Isn’t the End: Death returns you to the hub with most of your inventory intact, experience, and money.
Semi-Procedurally Generated Dungeons: Revisit anomaly dungeons multiple times to find different traps, enemies, puzzles, challenges – and loot! 
Co-Op: Fight the nightmare with a friend in 2-player Split-Screen Co-Op.
Character Options: Choose from 6 unique characters, each with their own backstory, stats, and ability loadouts.
Crafting: Dismantle, repair, and upgrade weapons; build ammo through gunpowder; and combine healing items to create new formulas and more!
Game Modes: Choose from 5 gameplay modes – Standard, Ironman, Randomizer, Lost Hope, and Easy Mode.
Uncover the Story: Search through notes and logs to read more from Lydia’s journal and piece together the past and future of the outbreak.
Late Game Content / New Game+: Face a randomly generated dungeon of extreme danger near the end of the game AND try multiple new game + modes after completing the story.

notes.title: Local co-op is coming to Outbreak!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

Well, we certainly have a theme going here. After both Outbreak: The New Nightmare and Outbreak: Epidemic received local co-op, it's time for Outbreak to shine. That's right - 2 player local co-op is finally here for Steam (and coming later in 2020 to consoles!).

Co-op Overview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26030162/7c6a597a18f46aef839416481d2bb6f75cf8b789.jpg
Outbreak supports 2-player splitscreen co-op in both the Campaign and Onslaught Modes. You can access local co-op through the "Local Game" menu (replacing the Single Player menu). On the lower left-side, there is a tickbox to enable local co-op and then a button to select the co-op player's character.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26030162/d54863d97825069c1dfa8deba5dfa8070c1c77d7.jpg
Just as with online co-op, everyone must select their own player. If you both select the same, it will automatically bump one of you to a different character. In addition, you can also choose to have AI teammates enabled - and this is huge - each player gets their own bot. Which means in a 2-player co-op game you can technically have 4 total players (2 human and 2 bot). This really ratchets up the action and allows you to more easily tackle the horrific Biohazard difficulty. You can of course choose to disable AI teammates if you want. Another cool thing is now (in both single-player and local co-op) your AI teammate will randomly select a weapon at the start of the match. Maybe you'll get lucky and they'll bring a Magnum to the fight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26030162/8b232c85bee66b7def789e434b5b289ad0a06334.jpg
In addition, your special starting inventory items (that you randomly find during gameplay and are selected prior to the beginning of a new scenario) are applied to BOTH co-op players. So when you go in guns blazing with Magnums or Grenade Launchers, your friends will benefit from that consumable as well.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26030162/3522a5fee6d0b9fa274c197c2ddddbebb879f59e.jpg
During gameplay, each human player has their own inventory and you can see everyone's items, health, etc.. from the lobby view. To help make co-op smoother, I've also added quick bindings to cycle through Handguns, Shotguns & Rifles, Power Weapons and Melee Weapons outside of the inventory (like in Outbreak: The New Nightmare and Outbreak: Epidemic). Make sure to bind these keys prior to playing oir reset your controls to defaults to pick them up.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26030162/641b8100cc1a15d8eec9aa38f094fac916daf27a.jpg
In Onslaught Mode, both players share the same credits, so make sure to coordinate as you buy equipment and fight off the waves of the undead.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26030162/3c341806ce6ce73a2260444781e7ea9e9186ee2c.jpg
Local co-op is considered an experimental mode. You may encounter bugs or other issues. Please report them in the forums so I can fix them quickly! Steam Remote Play Together should also work fine in Outbreak (as well as Outbreak: The New Nightmare and Outbreak: Epidemic).

Have fun and stay tuned for the patch notes coming very soon with other great improvements for Outbreak! We're 3 and a half years into this nightmare and this title keeps getting better and better!!

Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles is now available on Steam (Windows, Linux & OS X)!

Launch Packages and Discounts
During launch week, the base game (including the Season Pass and Complete Editions which offer a built-in discount) will have an additional 10% off. New story and Battle Mode content will be made available during 2018 and 2019! Lock in now at this great price!

About the Game
As the city burns and the countryside is engulfed by the epidemic, the living are increasingly alone and forced to live with this new reality. Monstrous beasts and disfigured remnants roam freely with their numbers increasing rapidly, slaughtering everything in their path. In the opening chapter, Lydia finds herself separated from her fellow survivors and all alone. After fleeing into a large manor estate to escape the relentless horde, her only goal now is survival. She must explore the manor, locate supplies and find a way to wake from this nightmare. But somehow... she knows her fate is already sealed.

Saving your game is also highly restrictive and you'll need to locate the means to record your progress as you explore. Lydia's adventure is just the beginning... can you survive the chronicles and determine the fate of the other survivors?

notes.title: Outbreak: The New Nightmare launches on Early Access June 20th!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8f393729c30aecbe46788fc9e1a455fcd4898449.png
We are pleased to announce that Outbreak: The New Nightmare is arriving on Steam Early Access on June 20th, 2017! During the release window, the game will have a discount of 40% off!

It has always been the goal of our Outbreak series to reach a point where it's finally realized in full high definition 3D. We're very happy to finally be bringing this experience to our fans early in the development cycle so they can have immense impact in the direction of the game. Launching in Early Access will allow everyone to play the game and provide their own thoughts on how it can grow!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8f96c2cf4119fabb159d0fda9dd479da940387dd.jpg
What's included in the initial Early Access release?
The initial release will include the tutorial, a single Campaign scenario and a single Onslaught mission. Don't fret, this is quite a bit of content to keep you busy!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/ff88c7aea815cbae6452a8df2912d5554f8b86fb.jpg
What will be added as the game produces through Early Access?
We already have several scenarios planned out to add over the coming months. Each of these new scenarios will also bring new Onslaught experiences... and perhaps a few other game modes as well. ;) We'll be looking to include new mechanics in these scenarios as we evolve this title past the basic framework of the original Outbreak game by Dead Drop Studios.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/8b3d570d99771da5c5464ee48b0629b0477e5a8d.jpg
What's the plan for pricing?
We're planning to raise the price over time as more content is added to the package. They will be gradual increases until we reach full release, which will launch at what we determine to be a fair price point. But, if you buy early, you'll get the entire game at a great price. Once you've purchased the Early Access version, you'll continue to get all of the new content as its added and already have the full game when it launches!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/2fd5d31c0babc8af0fbdffca3fc5c1f7f228b596.jpg
What about multiplayer and single player?
The Early Access release will come with up to 4-player online co-op multiplayer for ALL game modes. All of this content will also be playable in SINGLE PLAYER even OFFLINE!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28927398/1734befef0b3772727724019135f431b9c1869a0.jpg
What about trading cards?
As soon as we get sign-off from Valve post launch, we will be adding trading cards. They are already made and ready to go, we just need the green light!

Thank you to everyone who has supported our series so far. We're very excited to be taking this next step. We look forward to surviving with you!

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/297f215cca7de123581d3b369d7eca0809c89132.png
Hey Survivors! We're back again for another weekly update!

Outbreak: The New Nightmare Updates
After our launch on Steam Greenlight a few weeks back, development on Outbreak: The New Nightmare has continued at break neck speeds! Let's take a quick look and don't forget to vote for us on Steam Greenlight (and tell your friends)!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/b0784cd19a7dc4a2cc0fe8080d969f7e3f5f8b31.png
Updated Demo Playthrough Trailer
Check out the updated demo playthrough trailer and see all of the enhancements for yourself!

What's the release plan for Outbreak: The New Nightmare?
We're happy to announce that our plans for releasing O:TNN is to release on Steam Early Access as soon as we're able. Our plan is to develop this title fully with community feedback and ensure that this game becomes the best it can be. Once we've cleared Steam Greenlight, we'll provide more information about an anticipated release date. The goal is to make the initial offering meaty and then continue to add content, enhancements and fixes over time until it reaches a point where we can have a full release. Keep sharing the Greenlight page with your friends! We appreciate the support!

The Cast
The first four survivors of Outbreak: The New Nightmare have been announced! Right now in the pre-alpha build, they have many of the traits of the original four survivors from Outbreak. Expect these to get remixed in new ways before release, but this is just a preview of the beginning of the cast!

notes.content:

It's time for another weekend dev update, where I'll give you some behind-the-scenes look on Outbreak! I'll also catch you up on some releases from the last week!

Weekly Community Survival Sessions

"Care" - Nightmares scenario released! (Free)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/a5d5882817b2b0af990735060f38d431f94bbbe5.jpg
The latest Nightmares scenario, "Care", has been released! You'll take on the role of Ethan as he's busy working on his doctoral thesis (or... maybe playing some video games...). He hears a strange noise down the hallway and goes to investigate. As he attempts to survive this nightmare, he'll have to protect Nora (an unarmed NPC). Good luck surviving the undead threats as the lyceum burns to the ground around you!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/ca361cba6e263d13218ff51b69fdffff7aa05492.jpg

Difficulty Balancing Changes
We've recently pushed a new patch to reduce the frequency (and the amount of concurrent) monster spawns across the game. It's a small change in single-player, but you'll see a much larger change in multiplayer games with more players on lower difficulties. We'll continue to tweak game difficulty in the future with the goal of making "Normal" mode tough but fair. "Hard" mode is designed to be extremely hard and a bit unfair. "Biohazard" mode is designed to be completely unfair and brutal.

Thank you!
Thank you for continuing to play and support Outbreak! Keep the feedback coming and post your videos, screenshots and artwork to the game hub. If you've purchased Outbreak and enjoyed your experience, a positive Steam Review is greatly appeciated!

notes.title: Weekend Dev Update 3/5/2017
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

There has been a flurry of progress on Outbreak following our second free, large content drop from a week ago. Let's take a look at what's happening behind the scenes.

Nightmares - New Scenario "Care" (Free)
The second Nightmares scenario is under development and it's entitled "Care". In this scenario, you'll take control of Ethan who is busy working on his doctoral studies (but also may have been playing video games...). He gets up as he hears a scream down the hallway.

You'll find yourself exploring the Lyceum in the midst of an Outbreak. During your travels, you'll be joined by Nora. One of the unique aspects of this scenario is that Nora is unarmed and you'll need to protect her. If she dies, it's game over. You'll have to guide both characters to safety as the Lyceum is overrun with undead and slowly burns to the ground.

Don't worry. Even though Nora can't fight, she is very tough (at least in Normal difficulty...). Interested to see if folks can survive on Biohazard and keep both characters intact. This next scenario doesn't have an ETA, but will likely show up in a week or two...

Xbox One and Windows Store Ports
I've spent the first month since Outbreak has been out actively focusing on boosting content and getting community feedback integrated. As the game stabilizes, it's now time to put effort into porting it to new platforms. Xbox One and Windows Store are great future platforms for Outbreak. One of the things I'm looking forward to the most is grabbing some achievements for my Xbox Live profile! ːsteamhappyː

The Xbox One port is coming along very well. Virtually all functionality (including Xbox Live integration) is finished excluding multiplayer. It still needs thorough testing and edge cases, but the progress has been sizable in the last few weeks. I still don't have even a vague ETA for a release date. Integrating multiplayer will take a bit due to the third party services Outbreak uses. But I still feel the game is on track for a 2017 launch.

The Windows Store port is also coming along very well. The entire game, including multiplayer, is now playable completely. In addition, basic Xbox Live services have been integrated such as profile sign in, stats and achievements. The next step for this port is extensive testing and then working through certification. I would imagine this port is a few months out right now, but hopefully it will come along sooner.

What kind of fixes can we expect in the next patch?
The next patch should be addressing the following game issues:

    Additional player health buffs in multiplayer games. 2-player games now have health buffs very similar to playing in single-player mode.
    The character selection and starting equipment screens will now update the menu properly when mouse hovering over selections.
    Other small fixes and very minor enhancements.


New Control Scheme - Action Mouse Hybrid
We released a very small minor patch a few days back that added a new control scheme - Action Mouse Hybrid. This control scheme allows you to control your character's movement like the Action control scheme using your keyboard keys. But when you aim, control switches to the mouse and your character will face the mouse position. This creates an awesome 2D shooter control scheme, so definitely check it out!

You can change your control scheme in the Options menu under Player options. Remember! You can change your controls in-game as well. Use F1 or the Start button on your gamepad to access the options menu!

Community Playdates
I'm still working to find an appropriate time and way to organize regular community playdates to help everyone get a chance to try out the multiplayer. I should have more news on this in the next week or so. I also have some upcoming work getting put into some community growth, which you'll hear about in the next 3 weeks or so. The community is definitely growing and on a steady upswing. Keep telling friends about the game and encouraging them to play!

Thank you for supporting Outbreak!
Thank you again for playing and following Outbreak. Don't be shy about posting feedback and suggestions in the forums! Keep telling your friends about the game and posting about it on social media! The community is growing strong! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Content Drop 2 - Nightmares, Enemies, Character, AI and more!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/594f9a912cbfca70e544c4f34c38314fd3a318be.png
Outbreak - One Month Later...
Thanks to everyone who has supported Outbreak! We've had an amazing first month on Steam! During that month, the game has grown leaps and bounds based on community feedback in the form of free content, enhancements and fixes!

v1.14 just dropped which carried a ton of new content for both single and multiplayer gamers! Let's take a look!

Nora - The Seventh Survivor (Free)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/a136dbda1c7cc243c70d97986481a032cd103568.jpg
Nora joins the cast of survivors as she helps them survive with improved barricades. Nora's barricades have quite a bit more resistance and she doesn't incur a penalty on repeatedly using them like other characters. Nora is also unique because she starts with an unloaded shotgun. Either bring some of your own ammo or scavenge it in the hospital, but at least you've got a weapon! Nora was a free addition included with the recent v1.14 update!

Single Player AI Partner (Free)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/65cda197113eaf09a2dc486eae569745bb610f4e.jpg
One of the most requested features from the community is AI teammates (like from a certain popular survival horror game from the early 2000s). We've heard you loud and clear and the recent v1.14 patch includes the first stab at providing an optional AI partner.

From the single-player lobby (where you would start a campaign or Onslaught game), you can toggle the presence of your AI pal. Each main character has a fixed partner they will spawn with.

Although your AI teammate doesn't have the full functionality of another player, they do have some tricks up their sleeve. They'll follow you around the level and assist with dealing with threats. AI partners have unlimited ammo but they deal greatly reduced damage and still need to reload. They can take a punch (or bite) though as they're pretty durable. They will also slowly heal over time.

In the future, we'll look for ways to improve the AI partner system, perhaps even allowing inventory access and other gameplay elements. For now though, this is a great start and provides a buddy when you need some backup in the single-player campaign!

Nightmares - Single-player Vignettes (Free)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/56f4aece6748066924ad6f2609cee84035d6bcf8.jpg
Since Outbreak is a small indie game just starting out, it can sometimes be hard to find multiplayer games. As such, we're starting to bolster the amount of single-player content available to help the community as we continue to grow.

Nightmares is a unique single-player experience that diverges a bit from the standard Outbreak campaign. Nightmares trades in the endless hordes for a more classic survival horror experience. Although you won't be hunted endlessly, you will have to scrounge to find enough supplies to survive. Nightmares will also make use of the AI partner in some cases, and maybe a few guest appearances from other characters may pop up.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/e4daa8126a5b397115a76e54d8cf345164862a06.jpg
The first scenario, Captive, focuses on Quies escaping from a holding cell with Alendra and Stan. During her trek up to the surface hospital level, she'll encounter the mysterious Kass, who may either be a friend or enemy.

Please be sure to share your feedback on the first scenario. We're starting to break from a mold a tiny bit and we're interested to hear if folks are interested. More Nightmares scenarios will appear in the future in an episodic fashion.

New Onslaught Scenarios - Garage & Triage (Free)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/13020b61fa427adc8e20696cd64c440255f6de61.jpg
Onslaught continues to expand with the addition of Garage and Triage. Garage takes place during the Outbreak scenario finale as you attempt to survive the hordes in the parking garage. Triage takes place in the Primary Triage section (and Lab seciton) of the Outbreak scenario. You'll face new threats and old foes in these arenas.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/111d9615ef9e6d65c3d68df02dbd7d474ebb5d06.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/6be06d8ed7eed9102b179ff79f1031865bf2d7d2.jpg
New Enemies - Nurse & Oversized Zombie (Free)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/968428a4cf22fd9c4fabf1c0b49b29c346c766ed.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/729756cafad1b83c97b2ce12f11e177e0b829bc2.png
We've also added two new enemy types, the Nurse & the Oversized Zombie. You'll see them pop up randomly in the existing scenarios and they may take more of a focus in some upcoming Nightmares content!

These are just some of the new features and content provided for FREE in the latest version of Outbreak. In the last month, we've also added the following:

    Controls completely overhauled - modern tank, action and mouse look control schemes! (Select them in the Options menu!)
    Customizable mouse button controls!
    Support for consistency of controls across PS4, Xbox and other gamepads in the UI and in-game!

notes.title: Weekend Dev Update! - AI Partner / Nightmares Narrative Mode
notes.content:
As the long holiday weekend draws to a close, I'd just like to share some recent work!

Nightmares
Nightmares is a new narrative single-player experience that revisits locations from the campaign and provides short non-canon side-stories within them that do not relate to the main campaign mode. In Nightmares, your scenario will dictate the character you play as. Their abilities may also be slightly remixed to help improve the experience. Enemies and other events will be different.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/e7fe3814fa566c1d34a2ccbe09a01f2abb0f75bc.jpg
Nightmares is intended to be a slower-paced classic survival horror experience. Features like pausing in any UI are always enforced and enabled. In addition, the endless hordes are disabled and a greater focus on set-piece enemies and encounters. The addition of the AI partner system (see below) and other neat tricks will allow it to be a more strategically paced experience.

The plan is to release Nightmares as episodic content over time. The first episode's release doesn't have a release date and won't be in the incoming content drop, but we'll keep you posted as they come along.

AI Partner
One of the largest requests coming out of the community has been for supporting AI teammates. Our upcoming content drop & patch (which is hopefully dropping in the next week or two) will include initial, limited support.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/28c1a0c2a2e1582be864175fecf7a2416daaf969.png
In single-player Campaign and Onslaught, you will now be able to toggle an option to provide an AI teammate or not. In the initial release, this teammate will follow your player and attack incoming threats.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/53d3f564ca9bcc5a33b42d0f94e00ce3d07ddfc4.jpg
You won't be able to manage their inventory, so there are a few small changes made to support the experience. AI teammates will have unlimited ammo, but they will deal significantly less damage than other players. They also will need to reload like anyone else.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/7776a63c76d21a1bb0c634b6c28e11c7d56999d6.jpg
To help keep them alive, they will have buffed health compared to the average player. They will also slowly heal over time. They can help create a great diversion, but at the end of the day, you're responsible for supporting them and keeping them alive. If they die during the scenario, they're out for good. You can always choose to play solo and experience the classic Outbreak experience as it's always been! The choice is yours!

When will more content drop?
We're working on designing and building the new character and enemies. The hope is to release the next free content drop in the next week or two. Nightmares is targeted a bit further off and we'll have more information as the game continues. The content drop will also have a patch with a few big fixes like Quies's inventory glitching text with melee weapons and improved gamepad consistency in the UI system.

Thanks for supporting Outbreak!

notes.title: Outbreak Dev Weekly Update
notes.content:
As the work week draws to a close, I thought it'd be great to check in on some of the progress happening behind on the scenes on the game.

The Next Free Content Drop
I'm very busy generating some new content for the next release. My hope is for the next content drop to include a new character, some new enemies and an Onslaught scenario or two.

One of the scenarios not yet reflected in Onslaught mode is the Outbreak scenario. There are some notable areas, such as the Garage and Primary Triage. I'm working to find good ways to adapt these zones for the Onslaught experience.

The Garage will be an interesting scenario. Since it's rectangular with no hallways, it creates a unique take on Onslaught where camping a hallway becomes more difficult. Will you be able to survive 30 waves or more with enemies closing in from all angles?

Primary Triage is also a unique zone. Featuring the small food court, a few patient rooms and the advanced lab section, it'll provide some tight hallways and open areas to battle the horde. 

We'll have more to reveal about the new enemies and new character a little bit further down the road. The plan is to make all of this content free for everyone. Expect this content to drop in the next few weeks.

Console Port
I've also been hard at work on the Xbox One version of Outbreak. It's been a whirlwind of development as the game is now in a state where single player is accessible with the majority of features. Some major areas that will be under heavy development in the coming months is integrating Xbox services and getting multiplayer up and running.

The Xbox One version is still quite a ways off, but I remain optimistic we'll be seeing it sometime in 2017.

Spreading the Outbreak Community
Thank you to everyone in the community who has been providing feedback, both in the forums and on Steam reviews. If you've purchased and enjoyed Outbreak, a positive Steam review is greatly appreciated! If you have any feedback, please don't hesitate to post on the forums so we have a chance to meet your expectations. We want to make Outbreak great for everyone!

notes.title: Outbreak Major Content Drop - Scenarios/Characters/Customization & More!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the first major content drop for Outbreak is now available. It includes a significant amount of free content, as well as some new cosmetic DLC. Let's take a walk through the major changes.

New Characters - Stan and Kass - Free!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/ec34386d5bb5b9aab2fcff70b490c7bbe206effc.jpg
The community has been very vocal about the desire for new characters and that they should be free! We're happy to announce we've met both of those requirements with the addition of Stan and Kass to the character roster!

Stan
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/c50484380f220293a0755cca256a3444095541e5.png
Stan is a seasoned contractor and experienced foreman.

Stan is a melee focused character. He has tank-like health (similar to Mason) and has buffs for all melee interactions. Stan deals 20% more melee damage (with or without a melee weapon), has increased knockback and a higher chance for melee critical hits. Unfortunately, this all comes with a cost. Stan deals 20% damage with firearm attacks.

Stan is best played by folks who want to lead the charge and hold off the hordes while friends snipe over their shoulder from afar. Stan starts with the Pick, which is the most powerful melee weapon in the game. He's capable of significant damage right out of the gate!

Kass
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/aa80036cc4bc87815750a9fa0f24ef32ef21bce5.png
Kass is a retired police officer and seasoned detective.

Kass has some significant benefits as well. She can detect items (which become visible on your map) at a much greater range than other characters. She makes an effective single player character with a decent health level who can very easily find any piece of equipment around her. Even better, she is completely immune to poison status (either from enemy attacks or the environment).

Kass compliments a full party nicely by allowing her to enter areas full of poison that would destroy other teammates. She can be the lifeline to get that key lost in the poison on Miasma, or fend off a poisonous enemy (like the new Spider) first-hand.

New Onslaught Scenarios - Inferno & Depths - Free!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/e260733aa38813e6185449a826f59cf59b987a71.jpg
Inferno and Depths help broaden the Onslaught experience by returning to two areas of the campaign.

Inferno
Inferno takes place in the finale furnace hallway from Chasmal. With flames burning everywhere, you're trapped in a tight maze with a very linear path. Inferno doesn't have any locked doors, which means enemies can come from any area of the level. The evacuation hallway is still present, so you could choose to hold up there and make your stand if you wanted... but beware of enemies that will spawn close by and a lack of supplies.

Depths
Depths returns to the introduction of the Miasma scenario. Trapped in the Lyceum basement, you'll be forced to fend off the murderous hordes. You'll spawn with ample supplies around you, but you'll find that resources run thin very quickly, especially since threats can come from any direction. Can you survive 30 waves?

New Enemy - Spider - Free!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/1fa61b70e95520883a12f17dcc2d79986fc76387.png
The mutated spider joins the undead and monstrous ranks. Featuring a slash attack that will knock you back and a poisonous discharge when hit, it'll become a fearsome opponent. The spider helps mix up the current scenarios by randomly appearing in its two variations across the game. Be careful if you're a melee fighter!

New Player Customization - Free & Paid DLC
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/dca3f80a5fd478ae645859cf1a0d2d7d503ca26d.jpg
Outbreak now supports character skin changes for any character. These effects modify your appearance and can add some interesting cosmetic animations. Want to become a firery visage of your former self? Check! Want to become a hologram? Check!

We've provided four free customization options (Ice, Hologram, Invis & Bounce). For a small fee, you can also unlock the Fire, Lightning, Rainbow and Gold effects. These paid effects are premium offerings with cool animations or other effects.

You can grab them ala cart or as a bundle below!

    Fire Skin
    Rainbow Skin
    Lightning Skin
    Gold Skin


Thank you for playing Outbreak!
We're happy and excited to bring out new content. Thank you for supporting the game. Supporting our cosmetic DLC will help ensure we have the funds for further expansions in the future as well. Don't be shy about your feedback, keep telling friends about the game and posting on our forums. Thank you!

notes.title: Overhauled Controls - A Better Apocalypse
notes.content:
One of the largest pieces of feedback we've received for Outbreak since launch has been the default control scheme. Over a series of patches, we've made improvements to the default keybindings, adding mouse support and more. But at the core of the issues were the old school "Tank Controls".

Many users found the concept of only being able to move forward, backwards and turn very confusing. Tank controls were designed (and used) in classic survival horror games because they were difficult. They obfuscated the path between the player "wanting" to make an action and actually "making" it. Although they were a conscious design decision, it's important to embrace more modern approaches to improve the user experience and allow as many folks to play Outbreak as possible.

We're happy to announce the addition of multiple moving and turning control schemes, as well as changes to the default control scheme are now live in Outbreak.

The new schemes are:

    Modern Tank (Normal) (This is the new default for all players)
    Classic Tank (Pro)
    Action (Beginner)
    Mouse Look (Normal)
    Mouse look Action (Beginner)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/5aef4e0a7882d26f20be62ec9384076ed84281ca.jpg
Here's what these schemes entail...

Modern Tank (Normal)
Modern Tank works by turning AND moving the player at the same time in the direction you press. If you push "Up", you will turn to face that direction and begin forward at the same time. This will mean that you will quickly begin moving upwards. 

This scheme works great with a thumbstick because you can be very specific of your direction, but it also works great with a keyboard as you combine pushing both a horizontal and vertical direction at the same time.

Modern Tank represents a compromise in the name of fun between classic tank controls and straight-up action controls. It is the new default and the game will be balanced around this control scheme. We feel that it is a tremendous improvement over the previous default control scheme.

Classic Tank (Pro)
Classic Tank is essentially Outbreak's old default control scheme. It's classic punishing tank controls from the glory days of survival horror. Pros only!

Action (Beginner)
Action attempts to emulate typical action game controls and is best for beginners. Your character will fade the direction you intend to turn very quickly, allowing you to make rapid changes to your movement.

For example, if you press the left button or move your thumbstick in that direction you will begin moving left almost instantly. You still have control over diagonal movement by pressing a horizontal and vertical direction at the same time, so you remain precise.

This extra responsiveness can trivialize some areas of the game, as enemies are still bound by tank controls themselves. But if you're looking for a much easier, intuitive experience, action is the way to go.

Mouse Look (Normal)
Mouse Look controls cause the game to orient your character to always face the mouse position. There is still a delay on turning, which makes this scheme similar to the tank controls. Your character still only can move forward or backwards based on the way they're facing. The game is also primarily balanced around this control scheme. Any other controls to turn your player will be disabled in this mode.

Mouse Look Action (Beginner)
Mouse Look Action is the mouse look control scheme mixed with the Action scheme. Your character will face the direction of the mouse almost instantly, giving you far greater responsiveness. Just with the Action control scheme, this responsiveness trivializes the game somewhat and is intended for beginners. Any other controls to turn your player will be disabled in this mode.

But what about that mysterious button and key delay I've been experiencing?
We've received a large amount of feedback regarding delays when pushing buttons to move. This delay has always been intentional and able to be configured via the Options menu. But with the new default control scheme, we've made the new default no delay and have changed this setting for all users on their next game load to be set to none. We apologize for how confusing this was to new players.

What's next?
These control schemes are brand new and we want your feedback! We will continue to refine them in subsequent patches, so let us know your thoughts in the discussion boards. Thank you!

notes.title: DLC - First Packs Released & Future Plans!
notes.content:
We've been listening closely to community feedback since the release of Outbreak and have implemented a number of community requested features and fixes. One area that has recently been discussed is how we plan to handle free and paid DLC for Outbreak.

We're happy to announce that our plan is to typically make any potential character and scenario DLC free. To help fund the game, we will begin to provide cosmetic DLC including cosmetics that are influenced by game state as paid DLC. We're currently working to try to bring new characters and a scenario in the coming months, but we don't have a release date to share yet.

In the mean-time, we've launched our first set of cosmetic DLC as part of the flashlight and laser customization added in v1.10 of Outbreak. As part of that release, we added a number of free color choices for the flashlight and laser. For a small price, you can also add animated and game-state influenced cosmetics to your game.

The first cosmetic DLC includes:

    Outbreak - Flashlight and Laser Bundle (contains all DLC listed in this list) - 33% off!
    Rainbow Flashlight and Laser - Animates through a myriad of colors.
    Vital Signs Flashlight and Laser - Changes color based on your health status.
    Danger Close Flashlight and Laser - Changes color based on enemy proximity.
    Treasure Hunter Flashlight and Laser - Changes color based on nearby items.

We're going to try to see if cosmetic DLC can help offset the cost of producing additional characters and scenarios. That being said, there may be a time in the future where certain characters or scenarios may be paid DLC, but our intention is to keep as much free as we can afford.

Please make sure to post your feedback and suggestions for future DLC in our Steam Discussion Boards. Thanks for playing Outbreak and we're looking forward to surviving with you!

notes.title: Outbreak Release - Jan 17th, 2017!
notes.content:
The apocalypse draws near... Are you ready?

Release Date for Steam (Windows)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/4b58e67e89958eb2e7c7a2eebf015b71c9261e92.jpg
Check out the Outbreak Launch Trailer!

Outbreak's Steam release is set for January 17th, 2017! We have decided to pursue a full release instead of early access after evaluating the game in the final months of development. Outbreak will also feature a substantial launch discount for the first week after release!

Outbreak is launching with a swath of content including the campaign and onslaught modes. Every mode in Outbreak is playable with up to four-player online co-op and offline in single-player mode. In all modes you only have a single life. If you die, it's all over and the rest of your team is on their own.

Campaign follows the story of four survivors trapped in a hospital during a viral outbreak. The hospital has been overrun with hordes of mutated undead creatures. The survivors must methodically work through different areas, scrounge for supplies, fight off their persuers and try to find a way to escape. It's a brutal, unforgiving experience that scales up with multiple difficulty modes and based on the number of players in the game. With few supplies and an endless horde, you'll need to keep moving at all costs to survive!

Onslaught drops the horror of the campaign and trades it for all out action. The survivors must fight off endless waves of increasingly difficult monsters. When they slay monsters or clear waves, they will accumulate credits that can be spent on new weapons and equipment. Credits can also be spent to buy keycards and unlock more of the level, which will lead to increasingly better equipment.

Xbox One and Windows Store Ports - Much Later in 2017
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/e911aeb0ef81c72454c5da05166a80f748fb034f.jpg
We're also happy to announce that Outbreak will be coming to Xbox One and Windows Store much later in 2017! The Xbox One version will be a native game for Xbox One and will integrate Xbox Live functionality including achievements! The Windows Store version will be a UWP application. We'll have more news on these versions much later in 2017 as development is just getting underway. Any fixes or enhancements to the Steam version of Outbreak (outside of Steam-specific functionality) will be included in those ports when they release, so play it on Steam and send us feedback!

Let's Talk Multiplayer!
Outbreak does not use P2P connections for multiplayer gameplay. It utilizes a robust cloud-backend with region support that is nearly worldwide. When you start up Outbreak, it will automatically connect to the region with the best ping. 

You can override your region in the Options Menu. You must be on the same region as your friends to play together, so make sure to square that away first! Although each game will have a "host", all players (including the host) will be communicating with this backend service and not eachother directly. This means you should have virtually no NAT/Firewall punchthrough issues when trying to play with friends! The host does has elevated abilities to kick people from the game and return the group to the lobby at will though, so you can keep games under control.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/91e13cc47ec6a4fa6c2463a68086614f20e2923a.jpg
Playing with friends is easy! Just make sure you're all on the same region, enter a custom name for your game and start a private server. Your friends can then join via your server name (so make it easy to type or just paste it!). Once you have all of your friends in the game, simply make it public and other folks will join! Games can only be joined when you're in the room lobby.

Playing with strangers is just as easy! Either start up a public server or use the server browser and filtering options to find a game. You can mute voice chat from other players at any time as well (including yourself!).
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/821a8c516fd238fe7b200ca361482d10b1f14ae9.jpg

Outbreak - The Official Guide
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/74ec7e0dc9da74f652aeb5445098f92a37ac1361.jpg

Dead Drop Studios is building an official guide on Outbreak. It contains in-depth information about many aspects of the game, including the menu system, game mechanics, achievements and tons of other areas. Many common questions and issues are answered directly in the guide. Check it out and let us know about any new content you'd like to see in it!

Keep an eye on the Outbreak announcement section, the Outbreak website and our Twitter page for up-to-date information! We're very excited to share and play Outbreak with you. Keep telling your friends!

notes.title: The Epidemic Continues...
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/594f9a912cbfca70e544c4f34c38314fd3a318be.png

Outbreak lurches towards release with all new media and updates!

October Development Update
The focus over the last month has been adding game content like new scenarios, new features such as voice chat and polish. The four main game scenarios are now built and playable from start to finish. Each features a unique graphical theme to differentiate themselves, as well as different challenges and mechanics.

Features like online gameplay have received significant polish to ensure players are kept in sync well at all times. Voice chat is also natively implemented into the game and should "just work" when you join a game. You'll have all of the standard options like muting as well. New monsters and variants are also now included and there has been significant tuning to difficulty across all of the scenarios. The UI across the entire game has also been greatly polished and expanded to be more helpful and intuitive.

This month has also brought significant development of a new game mode in addition to the campaign, Onslaught. Rooted between the standard modern horde-mode and "extra" modes from classic survival horror, it provides more of an action-based shooter experience.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/13759e839daaab2d38a513e5d12eafdabbe3bf65.png

Miasma - The Third Scenario
Miasma takes place directly after the Chasmal scenario. After successfully dealing with an out of control furnace, the survivors attempt to reach safety within the hospital's medical college. Unfortunately, their meddling with the furnace has caused dangerous gases to leak into the area, which will poison them if they don't keep moving!

The medical college runs in stark contrast to the dark underground tunnels of Chasmal. It's more bright and festive as a major party was underway when the epidemic hit. You'll need to navigate the college and find a way out before the creatures or poison gas eliminates your group.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/6cde1d25eaeb82050b480e2adbd77e9f3cb5e310.png

Enkindle - The Final Scenario
Enkindle is the final chapter of the main Outbreak campaign. After the events in the medical college, our survivors find themselves trapped deep underground in a high-tech lab. There they will discover the source of the outbreak and attempt to make their final escape.

The major theme of Enkindle is a sterile, high-tech environment that has been ravaged by the undead threat. The player will need to navigate a dangerous maze as they desperately search for any way to escape. If you've played other classic survival horror experiences, you may be able to intuit how their adventure may end...

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/f7ff1473f097bdf003893925efe9d9f4c30b568f.png

Past The Campaign...
In addition to the co-op story campaign, Outbreak presents a fun extra single-player & co-op mode as a callback to classic survival horror games called Onslaught. Whereas the campaign is meant to be a linear horror-based experience with some action, Onslaught is the exact inverse. It's an open-ended horde-based survival mode where the survivors will battle wave after wave of monsters.

As they defeat additional monsters, they will gather resources that can be used to purchase equipment and unlock new areas of the level. Between each wave, they will receive a short amount of time to gather their supplies and organize their team before a new wave approaches.

Onslaught is designed to be an experience that forces both turtling and exploration gameplay. During the waves, you'll want to find a defensible room and use the combined firepower of your team to overwhelm the creatures. But your limited inventory means that supplies will run short quick. You'll have to strategically determine when it is the best time to run out and buy more ammo or weapons.

As the waves bleed on, new enemies will begin to appear offering higher payouts. Their health and speed will also continue to evolve as you continue to survive. The mode is endless and it's designed to be a frustrating but fun replayable experience. Only the best equipment will be hidden deep in the level behind the costliest barriers to clear.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/8d81f4ed44c4a348cfacd466c10df27623a9f062.jpg

We're So Close!
Outbreak is quickly approaching its early access launch in Winter 2016. We will be continuing to add content, polish and balance to the experience in the coming weeks. Expect to see some initial content from streamers in the coming month or two, as well as more of a concerted press push.

Keep telling your friends about Outbreak. We appreciate your support! Outbreak is the first step in realizing the return of multiplayer co-op survival horror. If we can find success in this game, we intend to continue to new experiences in different mediums including 3D. Supporting Outbreak will support a long-stream of survival horror experiences in the years to come!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/d7455f97bac74a706169b1de264808d6ce9eb14b.jpg

Thank you for reading. We look forward to surviving with you in Winter 2016!

notes.title: New Trailer and Screenshots!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/594f9a912cbfca70e544c4f34c38314fd3a318be.png

Outbreak now has a new trailer and screenshots available!

A fresh look in the apocalypse...
Outbreak received some major graphical upgrades in the last month. Featuring bloom lighting, lens flares, a dirty lens effect and more. Outbreak is a dark and somewhat gloomy experience, but there are brief respites of light in this nightmare. We wanted there to be a tradeoff to being in the light, most notably making it harder to see what is happening around you.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/8ac7bc10718fc501bf5d8f0bfd84aafa9fd8cb43.png

Chasmal, the second scenario...
We've recently hit content complete on the second full scenario in Outbreak, Chasmal. Chasmal takes place after the survivors initial visit to the hospital and features their attempt to escape through the underground. You'll learn more about the epidemic and deal with a particularly troublesome furnace. One of the major themes of Chasmal is fire, which has spread completely out of control.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/4600509023b42694a58ee1ef9d36f2bd7f4517a7.jpg

Game Enhancements
We've been hard at work squashing bugs and adding many quality-of-life improvements to the game. These have included massive improvements to the overall UI and general gameplay, but there's way too many to list here. One area we'd like to call out though is the map system. It will display the general area around you and mark important objects like items, doors and objectives. When you touch an item (or if you or a friend drops one), it will remain marked on your map. Friendly players will appear on the map with their associated in-game color.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/c281dd10a0813146697c020da44868dcccc5a96d.png

We just wanted to quickly mention that the project webpage for Outbreak has been updated with a new look. It also has all of the new media content outlined here. Check it out and share Outbreak with your friends!

Keep your eye on our Steam page and project website for updates! Thanks for your support and we're looking forward to surviving with you!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/b5e390be8cf3096df9fbc826ec052a9e3f590288.png

Danger is everywhere...
In Outbreak, you're chased by a never-ending horde of monsters bent on your destruction. There is no place to hide and supplies are incredibly limited. Your only chance for survival is to keep moving at all costs. As you explore, you'll find logs and notes left behind by survivors. It's also important to examine your surroundings which your character will comment on. This detail-oriented exploring will be essential for solving puzzles and finding keys to locked doors.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/d4041f28355da90635e032f19d4785622d709e42.png

Full support for Steam features!
Outbreak offers full support for Steam features like achievements, trading cards, inventory, in-app-purchases, trading between players and the community market. We will continue to expand the content offered here as the game enters early access and the eventual full release.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/a2df0df72b4199d48ae96021044567c873746bc7.png

Robust control options for everyone...
Survival horror has its modern roots on game consoles. Outbreak will ship with full gamepad support and in-game prompts for Xbox controllers. It will also have complete support for keyboards as well. Keyboard and gamepad controls are fully customizable within the game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26030162/9f7cd2d79c70dd7b056da23de4aed96068f4a9d0.png

Early Access coming in Winter 2016
Outbreak will launch on Steam Early Access in Winter 2016. When it launches, it will include both online multiplayer and offline single-player gameplay with most of the core game mechanics in-place. This will give the community an opportunity to provide feedback and influence the direction of the project. Check back here frequently for updates on the game's development and eventual release! Visit us at our official webpage and check us out on Twitter!

You only have one life in Outbreak. Survive the nightmare.
